title: Giant fourth-generation Propel testing protocol and stiffness results
notes: The manufacturer page was opened on 2026-09-23 and identifies the fourth-generation Propel Advanced SL frame size M, with a stated test protocol and frame pedaling stiffness 84 N/mm, frame torsional stiffness 124 N/degree, and fork stiffness 60 N/mm. These are manufacturer measurements, not an independent lab result.
